All specific claims in the statement are directly supported by the text.

The claim is explicitly stated and mathematically detailed in Source [S1], specifically in Section 7.3 ('PDFs of Long and Short Beams'). It further explains this as 'a new interpretation of short beams as a Russian roulette (RR) decision on the outcome of the long-beam estimator.'
